values: 变身为狼，获得更强的作战能力。
Shakir transforms into a wolf with more powerful combat capabilities.
沙奎尔变身为“狼形态”并扑向1个地图格，击飞处于该格的敌军并对周围2格范围内的敌人造成190% ATK伤害，释放期间处于霸体状态。沙奎尔每秒需要消耗60点能量来维持“狼形态”。处于“狼形态”时，沙奎尔生成2格范围的“狂狼光环”，并且普通攻击会对面前1格扇形区域内的所有敌军造成伤害。处于“狂狼光环”内的友军受到的伤害降低20% + 2%，提升10 + 3点急速。

Shakir morphs into a wolf and smashes a tile, knocking the enemy there into the air, and dealing 190% ATK damage to enemies within 2 tiles, during which he is unaffected. Shakir consumes 60 Energy per second to maintain his wolf shape. Shakir generates a Lupine Aura in a range of 2-tile while in the wolf shape, dealing damage to all enemies within the frontal radius of the arc with normal attacks. Allies within the range of Lupine Aura reduce 20% + 2% taken damage and increase 10 + 3 Haste.
“狂狼光环”内的友军受到的伤害降低20% + 2%，提升15 + 3点急速。
Reduces the allies' damage taken within Lupine Aura by 20% + 2% and increases their Haste by 15 + 3.
“狂狼光环”内的友军受到的伤害降低25% + 2%，提升15 + 3点急速。
Reduces the allies' damage taken within Lupine Aura by 25% + 2% and increases their Haste by 15 + 3.
“狂狼光环”内的友军受到的伤害降低25% + 2%，提升20 + 3点急速。
Reduces the allies' damage taken within Lupine Aura by 25% + 2% and increases their Haste by 20 + 3.
“狂狼光环”内的友军受到的伤害降低25% + 2%，提升25 + 3点急速。
Reduces the allies' damage taken within Lupine Aura by 25% + 2% and increases their Haste by 25 + 3.
连续发动3次攻击，狼形态下能够造成范围伤害。
Shakir launches 3 consecutive strikes, dealing AoE damage while in Wolf Form.
连续攻击目标3次，前2次攻击造成90% + 10% ATK伤害，第3次攻击造成160% + 20%伤害。处于“狼形态”时，技能范围变为前方1格扇形区域。

Shakir launches 3 consecutive strikes at an enemy, dealing 90% + 10% ATK damage with his first 2 attacks and 160% + 20% damage with his 3rd attack. While in Wolf Form, this skill damages enemies within a frontal 1-tile arc.
提升远程防御，变身为狼时额外提升生命汲取。
Gains Ranged DEF and Life Drain while in Wolf Form.
被动地，沙奎尔获得25点远程防御。沙奎尔在“狼形态”时处于霸体状态，并获得30 + 5点生命汲取，且“狂狼光环”中每个非召唤物友军会使自己获得5% + 1%的攻击力加成。
Passive. Shakir gains 25 Ranged DEF. In Wolf Form, he is unaffected and gains 30 + 5 Life Drain. Each non-summoned ally within Lupine Aura will also grants him 5% + 1% ATK.
被动获得的生命汲取提升至40 + 5。
Increases passive Life Drain bonus to 40 + 5.
被动获得的远程防御提升至30。
Increases passive Ranged DEF bonus to 30.
“狂狼光环”中每个非召唤物友军会使自己获得的攻击力加成提升至7.5% + 1%。
The bonus ATK from each non-summoned ally within Lupine Aura is increased to 7.5% + 1%.
降低自身受到的伤害，当“狂狼光环”中非召唤物友军数量较多时获得额外提升。
Shakir's damage taken is reduced during battle and is further reduced when multiple non-summoned allies are buffed by Lupine Aura.
战斗中，自身受到的伤害减少9%，且当“狂狼光环”范围中的非召唤物友军数量不少于2人时，受到的伤害额外减少4%。
Shakir reduces his damage taken by 9% during battle. His damage taken is further reduced by 4% if at least 2 non-summoned allies are buffed by his Lupine Aura.
战斗中，自身受到的伤害减少12%，且当“狂狼光环”范围中的非召唤物友军数量不少于2人时，受到的伤害额外减少5%。
Shakir reduces his damage taken by 12% during battle. His damage taken is further reduced by 5% if at least 2 non-summoned allies are buffed by his Lupine Aura.
战斗中，自身受到的伤害减少15%，且当“狂狼光环”范围中的非召唤物友军数量不少于2人时，受到的伤害额外减少7%。
Shakir reduces his damage taken by 15% during battle. His damage taken is further reduced by 7% if at least 2 non-summoned allies are buffed by his Lupine Aura.
Shakir can morphs into wolf in advance.
沙奎尔能量值超过700点时便可施放终极技能。沙奎尔在其每次施放终极技能之后的5秒内，维持“狼形态”不消耗能量。
Shakir can cast his Ultimate once his Energy exceeds 700. Shakir stays in Wolf Form and consumes no Energy within 5s each time after casting the Ultimate.
沙奎尔在其每次施放终极技能之后的7秒内，维持“狼形态”不消耗能量。
Shakir stays in Wolf Form and consumes no Energy within 7s each time after casting his Ultimate.
“狂狼光环”中每个非召唤物友军享受“狼王战意”中相同的攻击力加成。
Each non-summoned ally within Lupine Aura can share the same bonus ATK from Wolf's Will.
沙奎尔在其每次施放终极技能之后的8秒内，维持“狼形态”不消耗能量。
Shakir stays in Wolf Form and consumes no Energy within 8s each time after casting his Ultimate.
技能“烈爪锋刃”还能使目标降低受愈。
Shakir casts Savage Cleave to reduce the target's Vitality.
技能“烈爪锋刃”的第3次攻击还能在4秒使目标降低60点受愈。
Shakir reduces the target's Vitality by 60 within 4s using the 3rd hit of Savage Cleave.
